subject: Post-demo follow-up: LatticeHealth monthly burn band & procurement thresholds
messages:
From: Liam O'Neal <liam.oneal@latticehealth.com>

Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@latticehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo recap — LatticeHealth token volumes and budget

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the walk-through earlier — the demo and the ops examples were very helpful. Quick recap from our side and a couple of asks so we can get procurement lined up: 

Estimated usage (monthly):
- Core user flows (search + summarization): ~25–40M tokens/month
- Experimental screening flows: ~10–20M tokens/month
- Buffer for growth/spikes: ~10M tokens/month
=> Expected burn band: ~45–70M tokens/month for the first 3 months.

Budget model and procurement constraints:
- We have an internal target of $/1M tokens we can sign up for during pilot; target budget for pilot is $8k–$30k/month (we're aiming to keep initial spend under $15k while we validate).
- Procurement requires a PO for any monthly spend over $12,000; for larger commitments they prefer a master services agreement (MSA).

Two asks:
1) Can you confirm what pricing you would offer for a pilot at ~45–70M tokens/month, and what the per-1M-token price would be? If you have a simple worked example (line item by token band) that will make our procurement life easier.
2) Do you have SOC2 / security evidence PDFs we can attach to the PO request?

I've attached our rough usage estimate workbook (LatticeHealth_Usage_Estimates.xlsx). Priya (cc) is our procurement lead — copying her for timing and PO questions.

Ideal next steps: short pricing worksheet + one-pager SOC2 evidence, then we can route to procurement.

Thanks,
Liam

--

Hi Liam — great to meet you and thanks for the clear summary. Team, looping you in.

Quick answers up front:
- We can run a pilot for the 45–70M token/month band. For an introductory pilot we typically price at $420 / 1M tokens up to 50M tokens. If you stay within 50–100M tokens, we apply a tiered discount schedule (we can show three tiers in the worksheet).
- PO threshold: Redwood can accept a purchase order for monthly spend > $12k. For multi-month committed discounts or > $60k/month we would move to a short MSA + SOW.
- SOC2 and security evidence: attaching a short SOC2 summary and our security factsheet.

I've attached: redwood-pilot-pricing-worksheet.xlsx and redwood-soc2-summary.pdf — the worksheet shows worked examples for 45M, 60M, and 90M monthly burns with per-1M breakdowns and monthly totals.

Next steps proposed: 
1) I’ll send the pricing worksheet now (attached). Confirm which worked-example (45M vs 60M) you want us to use for a PO.
2) If procurement needs the SOC2 artifact inline with the PO, we can provide the PDF and a short note for their security review.
3) Connor — can you confirm whether we can do a 30-day pilot invoice with PO for $12k–$15k and apply a credit toward committed spend if converted within 60 days?
4) Liam / Priya — if you can confirm the target monthly commitment (or a target cap) and the procurement lead timeline, we’ll prepare a formal SOW + invoice path.

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call if useful.

Best,

Forwarding the thread — quick internal notes and proposed approach before we lock pricing: 

Quoted message:
> From: Liam O'Neal <liam.oneal@latticehealth.com>
> Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 14:12:00 -0700

My notes / suggested program: 
- Pilot offer (external-facing): $420 / 1M tokens up to 50M tokens/month. This gets them into a low-friction PO path (<=$12k/month).
- If they want to target 60–70M tokens/month, propose a two-month elevated pilot price (same $/1M for month 1, 10% discount on month 2) while we monitor quality.
- Committed discounts: 5% at 100M+, 10% at 200M+. (These are typical bands; we can tighten if Connor prefers.)
- Procurement: PO threshold is $12k/month. For anything >$60k/month, require MSA + SOW; legal lead time estimate ~2–3 weeks.
- Risk notes: their growth spikes + experimental flows might push them to 100M before procurement completes — recommend setting a soft cap in the SOW or auto-alerting for spend >85M/month.

Action items: 
- Connor: confirm the pilot-invoice-credit policy (can we issue a 30-day invoice for $12k–$15k that is creditable against a subsequent committed invoice?).
- Sofia: once Connor confirms, prepare a concise SOW template and include the security artifacts link. Also confirm SLA expectations for pilot traffic (burst tolerance).
- Vanessa: if approved, send the finalized worksheet + SOC2 PDF to Liam and Priya and propose a signature/PO target date.

Attachments to include on outbound: redwood-pilot-pricing-worksheet.xlsx, redwood-soc2-summary.pdf, plus LatticeHealth_Usage_Estimates.xlsx they provided.

Thanks — I’ll hold off on any binding pricing until Connor confirms the credit policy.

- Vanessa

- Week of Aug 2: procurement routes PO internally (Priya)
- Week of Aug 9: Redwood issues pilot invoice and we provision keys
- By Sep 20: internal validation readout and commit decision

I'll circulate the PO contact details to you today. Thanks again — looking forward to getting started.
